fact: Banco Nacional de Angola says Aviso 12/2016 sets rules and procedures for marketing financial products and services, including those of payment-service providers, as consumer-protection conduct supervision.

Banco Nacional de Angola launched the complaints-management module of its Portal do Consumidor Bancário for non-bank financial institutions, payment-service providers among them, to register and process consumer complaints.
BNA Aviso 7/17 sets transparency, information and contract rules for payment service users and requires providers to follow financial consumer protection rules, in force 30 days after publication.
